theory.intro: A timetable is a table of times. Each row is usually a stop or service and each column is a time, often written in 24-hour notation.
facts: Read **down a column** to follow one trip; read **across a row** to follow one stop.
Find the cell where the right row and column meet.
To find a journey length, subtract the start time from the finish time.
steps: Read the time where they meet — convert to 12-hour if asked.

foundation.question_text: The ferry timetable is $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{F1}&\text{F2}\\\hline\text{Harbour}&0810&0940\\\text{Island}&0845&1015\end{array}$. When does F2 leave Harbour?
foundation.solution_text:
Read the Harbour row and F2 column.
F2 leaves Harbour at $0940$.

foundation.question_text: The clinic timetable is $\begin{array}{c|ccc}\text{Doctor}&\text{Lee}&\text{Khan}&\text{Roy}\\\hline\text{Morning}&0900&0930&1000\\\text{Afternoon}&1330&1400&1430\end{array}$. When is Dr Khan's afternoon session?
foundation.solution_text:
Read the Afternoon row and Khan column.
Dr Khan's session is at $1400$.

foundation.question_text: A bus timetable shows $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{Route 3}&\text{Route 8}\\\hline\text{Park}&0715&0740\\\text{Library}&0735&0805\end{array}$. Which route reaches the Library first?
A cinema timetable is $\begin{array}{c|cc}\text{Film}&\text{Matinee}&\text{Evening}\\\hline A&1420&1830\\B&1505&1915\end{array}$. What time is Film A's evening session in 12-hour notation?
A train table lists $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{T1}&\text{T2}\\\hline\text{Central}&1050&1120\\\text{Beach}&1135&1205\end{array}$. How long does T1 take from Central to Beach?
A pool timetable is $\begin{array}{c|cc}\text{Class}&\text{Mon}&\text{Wed}\\\hline\text{Beginners}&1615&1645\\\text{Squad}&1730&1800\end{array}$. When is the Wednesday Beginners class?
foundation.solution_text:
Read the Beginners row and Wednesday column.
The class is at $1645$.

development.question_text: Use $\begin{array}{c|ccc} &\text{S1}&\text{S2}&\text{S3}\\\hline\text{Hill}&0825&0910&0955\\\text{Town}&0850&0935&1020\\\text{Lake}&0920&1005&1050\end{array}$. Which service reaches Lake before $10{:}30$ am but leaves Hill after $9$ am?
development.solution_text:
S2 leaves Hill at $0910$ and reaches Lake at $1005$.
S3 reaches Lake after $10{:}30$ am.
The service is **S2**.

development.question_text: A shuttle table is $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{A}&\text{B}\\\hline\text{Airport}&1340&1525\\\text{Hotel}&1420&1600\end{array}$. Which shuttle has the shorter journey?
development.solution_text:
$1340\to1420=40\text{ min}$
$1525\to1600=35\text{ min}$
Shuttle B is shorter by $5$ minutes.

development.question_text: Use $\begin{array}{c|ccc}\text{Museum tour}&\text{Red}&\text{Blue}&\text{Gold}\\\hline\text{Start}&10{:}15\text{ am}&1245&2{:}20\text{ pm}\\\text{Finish}&11{:}05\text{ am}&1335&3{:}10\text{ pm}\end{array}$. Which tour starts at $1440$ in 24-hour time?
development.solution_text:
$1440=2{:}40\text{ pm}$
None of the listed tours starts at $2{:}40$ pm.

development.question_text: A library van follows $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{Tuesday}&\text{Friday}\\\hline\text{North}&0905&1015\\\text{East}&0940&1050\\\text{South}&1025&1135\end{array}$. On Friday, how long passes from North to South?

A sports timetable is $\begin{array}{c|ccc}\text{Event}&\text{Start}&\text{Finish}&\text{Court}\\\hline\text{Tennis}&0835&0950&2\\\text{Netball}&1010&1125&1\end{array}$. A spectator arrives at $10{:}00$ am. Which event can they still watch?
development.solution_text:
Tennis finishes at $0950$, before arrival.
Netball begins at $1010$, after arrival.
The spectator can watch **Netball**.

development.question_text: A route table shows $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{Local}&\text{Express}\\\hline\text{West}&1710&1735\\\text{City}&1815&1820\end{array}$. How much later does the Express leave West, and how much shorter is its journey?
development.solution_text:
The Express leaves $25$ minutes later.
Local duration: $1710\to1815=65\text{ min}$.
Express duration: $1735\to1820=45\text{ min}$.
The Express journey is $20$ minutes shorter.

mastery.question_text: Use $\begin{array}{c|ccc} &\text{R1}&\text{R2}&\text{R3}\\\hline\text{Depot}&2215&2305&2350\\\text{Terminal}&2255&2345&0030\end{array}$. Which service arrives on the next day, and how long is its trip?
mastery.solution_text:
R3 crosses midnight.
$2350\to2400=10\text{ min}$
$0000\to0030=30\text{ min}$
$10+30=40\text{ min}$

mastery.question_text: A timetable gives $\begin{array}{c|ccc} &\text{P1}&\text{P2}&\text{P3}\\\hline\text{Start}&1145&1210&1250\\\text{Finish}&1235&1300&1345\end{array}$. Sam must arrive by $1{:}10$ pm and cannot leave before noon. Which services work?
mastery.solution_text:
P1 leaves before noon, so it does not work.
P2 leaves at $1210$ and arrives at $1300$, so it works.
P3 arrives at $1345$, too late.
Only **P2** works.

mastery.question_text: A ferry timetable is $\begin{array}{c|ccc} &\text{F1}&\text{F2}&\text{F3}\\\hline\text{Leave}&0640&0725&0810\\\text{Arrive}&0740&0810&0850\end{array}$. Which trip is fastest, and how much faster is it than the slowest trip?
mastery.solution_text:
F1 takes $60$ minutes.
F2 takes $45$ minutes.
F3 takes $40$ minutes.
F3 is fastest and is $20$ minutes faster than F1.
